#### fresh generation
# github-build --organization test-org --skip_repository_settings --skip_gitignore --skip_slack --application_name demo-app
---
name: Build
'on':
  pull_request:
    types:
    - opened
    - edited
    - reopened
    - synchronize
  push:
    branches:
    - master
    - "[0-9]*"
    - dependabot/**
    tags:
    - "**"
permissions:
  contents: read
env:
  PHP-TOOLS: composer
  PHP-VERSION: <php-version>
concurrency:
  group: build-${{github.ref}}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  variables:
    name: Prepare Variables
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      BUILD_NAME: "${{steps.variables.outputs.BUILD_NAME}}"
      BUILD_VERSION: "${{steps.variables.outputs.BUILD_VERSION}}"
      COMMIT_MESSAGE: "${{steps.variables.outputs.COMMIT_MESSAGE}}"
      MODIFIED_GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: "${{steps.variables.outputs.MODIFIED_GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_BETA: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_BETA}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_RC: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_RC}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_PROD: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_PROD}}"
      DEPLOY_MACOS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_MACOS}}"
      DEPLOY_TVOS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_TVOS}}"
      DEPLOY_OPTIONS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_OPTIONS}}"
      SKIP_LICENSES: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_LICENSES}}"
      SKIP_LINTERS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS}}"
      SKIP_TESTS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS}}"
      UPDATE_PACKAGES: "${{steps.variables.outputs.UPDATE_PACKAGES}}"
      LINTERS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Prepare variables
      id: variables
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/variables@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
  golangci:
    name: Go Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Golangci-lint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/golangci@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
  phpcs:
    name: PHP CS Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: PHPCS
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/phpcs@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
  phpstan:
    name: PHP Stan Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: PHPStan
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/phpstan@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
  semgrep:
    name: Semgrep Security Scanner
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Semgrep
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/semgrep@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
  trivy:
    name: Container & IaC Vulnerability Scanner
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Trivy
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/trivy@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
  yamllint:
    name: YAML Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Yamllint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/yamllint@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
  licenses:
    name: Licenses Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LICENSES != '1'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Licenses
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/soup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        parameters: "--no_prompt"
  go_unit_tests:
    name: Go Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS != '1'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Setup
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/setup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
    - name: Go Modules
      shell: bash
      run: go mod vendor
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{github.token}}"
    - name: Testing
      shell: bash
      run: go test
  php_unit_tests:
    name: PHP Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS != '1'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Setup
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/setup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        php-version: "${{env.PHP-VERSION}}"
        php-tools: "${{env.PHP-TOOLS}}"
    - name: Composer
      shell: bash
      run: composer install
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{github.token}}"
    - name: PHPUnit
      shell: bash
      run: vendor/bin/phpunit
  codedeploy:
    name: Code Deploy
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    - golangci
    - phpcs
    - phpstan
    - semgrep
    - trivy
    - yamllint
    - licenses
    - go_unit_tests
    - php_unit_tests
    if: "${{always() && (needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_BETA == '1' || needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_RC == '1' || needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_PROD == '1') && needs.variables.result != 'failure' && needs.golangci.result != 'failure' && needs.phpcs.result != 'failure' && needs.phpstan.result != 'failure' && needs.semgrep.result != 'failure' && needs.trivy.result != 'failure' && needs.yamllint.result != 'failure' && needs.licenses.result != 'failure' && needs.go_unit_tests.result != 'failure' && needs.php_unit_tests.result != 'failure'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Setup
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/setup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
    - name: Go Modules
      shell: bash
      run: go mod vendor
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{github.token}}"
    - name: Setup
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/setup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        php-version: "${{env.PHP-VERSION}}"
        php-tools: "${{env.PHP-TOOLS}}"
    - name: Composer
      shell: bash
      run: composer install
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{github.token}}"
    - name: Update Packages
      shell: bash
      if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.UPDATE_PACKAGES == '1'}}"
      run: touch update-packages
    - name: Zip
      shell: bash
      run: zip --quiet --recurse-paths "${{needs.variables.outputs.BUILD_NAME}}.zip" ./*
    - name: S3Copy
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/codedeploy/s3copy@v3
      with:
        aws-access-key-id: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID || ''}}"
        aws-secret-access-key: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY || ''}}"
        aws-region: "${{secrets.AWS_DEFAULT_REGION}}"
        aws-role-to-assume: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME}}"
        source: deployment
        target: s3://${{secrets.CODEDEPLOY_BUCKET}}/${{github.repository}}
  beta_deploy:
    name: Beta Deploy
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    - codedeploy
    if: "${{always() && needs.codedeploy.result == 'success' && needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_BETA == '1'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Beta Deploy
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/codedeploy/deploy@v3
      with:
        aws-access-key-id: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID || ''}}"
        aws-secret-access-key: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY || ''}}"
        aws-region: "${{secrets.AWS_DEFAULT_REGION}}"
        aws-role-to-assume: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME}}"
        application-name: demo-app
        deployment-group-name: beta
        s3-bucket: "${{secrets.CODEDEPLOY_BUCKET}}"
        s3-key: "${{github.repository}}/${{needs.variables.outputs.BUILD_NAME}}.zip"
  rc_deploy:
    name: Rc Deploy
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    - codedeploy
    if: "${{always() && needs.codedeploy.result == 'success' && needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_RC == '1'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Rc Deploy
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/codedeploy/deploy@v3
      with:
        aws-access-key-id: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID || ''}}"
        aws-secret-access-key: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY || ''}}"
        aws-region: "${{secrets.AWS_DEFAULT_REGION}}"
        aws-role-to-assume: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME}}"
        application-name: demo-app
        deployment-group-name: rc
        s3-bucket: "${{secrets.CODEDEPLOY_BUCKET}}"
        s3-key: "${{github.repository}}/${{needs.variables.outputs.BUILD_NAME}}.zip"
  prod_deploy:
    name: Prod Deploy
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    - codedeploy
    if: "${{always() && needs.codedeploy.result == 'success' && needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_PROD == '1'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Prod Deploy
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/codedeploy/deploy@v3
      with:
        aws-access-key-id: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID || ''}}"
        aws-secret-access-key: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY || ''}}"
        aws-region: "${{secrets.AWS_DEFAULT_REGION}}"
        aws-role-to-assume: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME}}"
        application-name: demo-app
        deployment-group-name: prod
        s3-bucket: "${{secrets.CODEDEPLOY_BUCKET}}"
        s3-key: "${{github.repository}}/${{needs.variables.outputs.BUILD_NAME}}.zip"

#### regeneration over a customized build.yml
# github-build --organization test-org --skip_repository_settings --skip_gitignore --skip_slack --application_name demo-app
---
name: Build
'on':
  pull_request:
    types:
    - opened
    - edited
    - reopened
    - synchronize
  push:
    branches:
    - master
    - "[0-9]*"
    - dependabot/**
    tags:
    - "**"
permissions:
  contents: read
env:
  CUSTOM_WORKFLOW_ENV: kept
  PHP-TOOLS: composer
  PHP-VERSION: <php-version>
concurrency:
  group: build-${{github.ref}}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  variables:
    name: Prepare Variables
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      BUILD_NAME: "${{steps.variables.outputs.BUILD_NAME}}"
      BUILD_VERSION: "${{steps.variables.outputs.BUILD_VERSION}}"
      COMMIT_MESSAGE: "${{steps.variables.outputs.COMMIT_MESSAGE}}"
      MODIFIED_GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: "${{steps.variables.outputs.MODIFIED_GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_BETA: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_BETA}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_RC: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_RC}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_PROD: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_PROD}}"
      DEPLOY_MACOS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_MACOS}}"
      DEPLOY_TVOS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_TVOS}}"
      DEPLOY_OPTIONS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_OPTIONS}}"
      SKIP_LICENSES: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_LICENSES}}"
      SKIP_LINTERS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS}}"
      SKIP_TESTS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS}}"
      UPDATE_PACKAGES: "${{steps.variables.outputs.UPDATE_PACKAGES}}"
      LINTERS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Prepare variables
      id: variables
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/variables@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
  actionlint:

      contents: read

        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
  golangci:
    name: Go Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: custom-runner
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: Golangci-lint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/golangci@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"

        custom-input: kept
      env:

  phpcs:
    name: PHP CS Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read

        php-tools: "${{env.PHP-TOOLS}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: Composer
      shell: bash
      run: composer install --customized
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{github.token}}"
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: Update Packages
      shell: bash
      if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.UPDATE_PACKAGES == '1'}}"
      run: touch update-packages
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: Zip
      shell: bash
      run: zip --quiet --recurse-paths "${{needs.variables.outputs.BUILD_NAME}}.zip" ./* --customized
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: S3Copy
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/codedeploy/s3copy@v3
      with:
        aws-access-key-id: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID || ''}}"
        aws-secret-access-key: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY || ''}}"
        aws-region: "${{secrets.AWS_DEFAULT_REGION}}"
        aws-role-to-assume: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME}}"
        source: deployment
        target: s3://${{secrets.CODEDEPLOY_BUCKET}}/${{github.repository}}
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
  beta_deploy:
    name: Beta Deploy
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    - codedeploy
    if: "${{always() && needs.codedeploy.result == 'success' && needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_BETA == '1'}}"
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42

        application-name: demo-app
        deployment-group-name: beta
        s3-bucket: "${{secrets.CODEDEPLOY_BUCKET}}"

        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept

#### idempotent regeneration
# github-build --organization test-org --skip_repository_settings --skip_gitignore --skip_slack --application_name demo-app
---
name: Build
'on':
  pull_request:
    types:
    - opened
    - edited
    - reopened
    - synchronize
  push:
    branches:
    - master
    - "[0-9]*"
    - dependabot/**
    tags:
    - "**"
permissions:
  contents: read
env:
  CUSTOM_WORKFLOW_ENV: kept
  PHP-TOOLS: composer
  PHP-VERSION: <php-version>
concurrency:
  group: build-${{github.ref}}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  variables:
    name: Prepare Variables
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      BUILD_NAME: "${{steps.variables.outputs.BUILD_NAME}}"
      BUILD_VERSION: "${{steps.variables.outputs.BUILD_VERSION}}"
      COMMIT_MESSAGE: "${{steps.variables.outputs.COMMIT_MESSAGE}}"
      MODIFIED_GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: "${{steps.variables.outputs.MODIFIED_GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_BETA: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_BETA}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_RC: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_RC}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_PROD: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_PROD}}"
      DEPLOY_MACOS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_MACOS}}"
      DEPLOY_TVOS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_TVOS}}"
      DEPLOY_OPTIONS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_OPTIONS}}"
      SKIP_LICENSES: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_LICENSES}}"
      SKIP_LINTERS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS}}"
      SKIP_TESTS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS}}"
      UPDATE_PACKAGES: "${{steps.variables.outputs.UPDATE_PACKAGES}}"
      LINTERS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Prepare variables
      id: variables
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/variables@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
  actionlint:
    name: Github Actions Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Actionlint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/actionlint@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
  golangci:
    name: Go Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: custom-runner
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: Golangci-lint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/golangci@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
  phpcs:
    name: PHP CS Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: custom-runner
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1'}}"
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: PHPCS
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/phpcs@v3
      with:

        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
  phpstan:
    name: PHP Stan Linter

      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept

        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
  go_unit_tests:
    name: Go Unit Tests
    runs-on: custom-runner
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS != '1'}}"
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: Setup
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/setup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: Go Modules
      shell: bash
      run: go mod vendor --customized
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{github.token}}"
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: Testing
      shell: bash
      run: go test --customized
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
  php_unit_tests:
    name: PHP Unit Tests
    runs-on: custom-runner
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS != '1'}}"
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: Setup
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/setup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        php-version: "${{env.PHP-VERSION}}"
        php-tools: "${{env.PHP-TOOLS}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: Composer
      shell: bash
      run: composer install --customized
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{github.token}}"
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: PHPUnit
      shell: bash
      run: vendor/bin/phpunit --customized
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
  codedeploy:
    name: Code Deploy
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    - actionlint
    - golangci
    - phpcs
    - phpstan
    - semgrep
    - trivy
    - yamllint
    - licenses
    - go_unit_tests
    - php_unit_tests
    if: "${{always() && (needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_BETA == '1' || needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_RC == '1' || needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_PROD == '1') && needs.variables.result != 'failure' && needs.actionlint.result != 'failure' && needs.golangci.result != 'failure' && needs.phpcs.result != 'failure' && needs.phpstan.result != 'failure' && needs.semgrep.result != 'failure' && needs.trivy.result != 'failure' && needs.yamllint.result != 'failure' && needs.licenses.result != 'failure' && needs.go_unit_tests.result != 'failure' && needs.php_unit_tests.result != 'failure'}}"
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: Setup
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/setup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: Go Modules

        GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{github.token}}"

    - name: Setup

        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        php-version: "${{env.PHP-VERSION}}"
        php-tools: "${{env.PHP-TOOLS}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: Composer

        custom-input: kept

        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
